subject: Aaron Olapade School Committee Candidacy
overview: Medford Bytes interviewed School Committee candidate Aaron Olapade regarding his candidate platform, background in community service, approach to school safety, and vision for curriculum reform.

items.title: Introduction and Local Dining Favorites
items.summary: School Committee candidate Aaron Olapade introduced himself and highlighted Snappy Patty's and Tasty on the Hill as his favorite Medford dining spots.

items.title: Candidate Background and Motivation to Run
items.summary: Olapade discussed growing up in Medford, his faith-based commitment to community service, and how his educational gap year inspired his School Committee candidacy.

items.title: School Safety and Student Well-Being
items.summary: Olapade addressed school safety by emphasizing the need for open daily conversations, strong student representation, and support for student emotional and intellectual health after COVID-19.

items.title: Educational Philosophy and Curriculum Reform
items.summary: Olapade proposed competency-based learning and progressive, step-by-step updates to the curriculum to incorporate diverse authors and historical contexts.

items.title: Community Strengths and Local Progress
items.summary: Olapade praised Medford's community-driven intentionality around diversity, equity, and inclusion while noting the need to maintain engagement post-pandemic.

items.title: Personal Routine and Rowing Background
items.summary: Olapade described his early morning rowing and structured daily routine, reflecting on how team sports influenced his leadership mindset.

items.title: Community Advocacy and Service Roles
items.summary: Olapade detailed his advocacy work as youth coordinator for the Mystic Valley NAACP and his former role as African American community liaison for the Medford Health Department.

items.title: Campaign Kickoff Event Announcement
items.summary: Olapade announced a joint campaign kickoff event with fellow candidate Erica Reinfeld set for August 28 at 7 Ronale Road.
